newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Two killed in Albania shootout.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Albania shootout.

text.p: Two people were killed in a gun battle in the southern Albanian port city of Vlore on Saturday in the latest incident of lawlessness in the Balkan state.
Police said the gun battle appeared to be a continuation of fighting on Friday evening when two local gangs clashed with light arms and anti-tank weapons in a southern suburb.
They said Bernard Ducka, 20, was incinerated in his car which was hit with an anti-tank shell on Friday evening. Five people were wounded and one of them, a 16-year-old, died on Saturday.
Two of the wounded were evacuated to Italy aboard military helicopters in critical condition on Saturday evening.
Unofficial estimates say that up to a million weapons have been looted from military arsenals in unrest over failed pyramid investment schemes that swept Albania to the brink of anarchy in March.
Several hundred people have been killed, many of them accidentally, since March.
